verdictSummary: Review03 RF1 is closed on the frozen subject-04 bytes. The corrected profile denies child replacement of every Node/Rust write root. The parent independently refuses if a root's identity changes. The same exploit still reproduces on subject-03 in this session. There are no new required findings. Acceptance covers the concrete adapter and fixed macOS development host profile only. It is not hermetic, not product integration or install, not runtime/release qualification, and not M1 acceptance.

codeReview: child_profile write grant is (require-all (subpath p) (require-not (literal p))) for every Node/Rust write root, matching the Python profile.

The parent records lstat (st_dev, st_ino) of output, runtime-scratch and home after creating them. verify_directory_roots runs before each profile is rendered and after each Node/Rust child exits, refusing non-directories (symlinks) and replaced inodes.
Children run sequentially, and fork/exec are denied, so no child can act between the post-check and the next profile rendering.
Later grants are the same paths, now proven to be the parent-created directories.
